title.value: Pre-Training Protein Encoder via Siamese Sequence-Structure Diffusion Trajectory Prediction
title.justification: The title captures the main theme of the paper which is about pre-training a protein encoder using a novel diffusion trajectory prediction technique.
title.quote: Title: Pre-Training Protein Encoder via Siamese Sequence-Structure Diffusion Trajectory Prediction

extractions.description: The paper proposes a method named DiffPreT to pre-train protein encoders by employing sequence-structure joint diffusion modeling, and introduces Siamese Diffusion Trajectory Prediction (SiamDiff) to enhance this process by considering different protein conformers. The approach is evaluated on protein understanding tasks, showing competitive results.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's focus is on protein structure and function prediction using deep learning techniques, without a direct emphasis on climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this work, inspired by the success of denois-ing diffusion models in generative tasks, we propose the DiffPreT approach to pre-train a protein encoder by sequence-structure joint diffusion modeling.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly address any specific area of climate or ecological sustainable development.
primary_category.quote: Is Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development a central theme of the paper: No

primary_sub_category.justification: No specific sub-category applies as the paper is centered around protein modeling techniques.
primary_sub_category.quote: Primary Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development sub-category of the paper: N/A

new_primary_category.justification: The content of the paper focuses on new methods to encode proteins effectively, which is more relevant to protein modeling and understanding rather than a defined sustainable development category.
new_primary_category.quote: Pre-Training Protein Encoder via Siamese Sequence-Structure Diffusion Trajectory Prediction

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's innovative approach is centered around predicting the joint distribution of protein sequences and structures, a specific aspect of protein modeling.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Our proposed approach, called DiffPreT, gradually adds noise to both protein sequence and structure to transform them towards random distribution, and then denoises the corrupted protein structure and sequence using a noise prediction network.
